description: This file defines a class 'Image_Graph_DataSelector_EveryNthPoint' that filters data points to include only every Nth point, used for reducing data points in graph rendering.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataSelector_EveryNthPoint
classes.description: A data selector class that filters points to include only every Nth point based on a specified interval.

methods.name: Image_Graph_DataSelector_EveryNthPoint
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the interval for selecting points, defaulting to 10.

methods.name: _select
methods.description: Determines if a given set of values should be selected (shown) based on the point interval.
